items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I still listen to my favorite guys, you know, like Prokofiev... we all learned... from Ravel, Debussy, and Prokofiev, Shostakovich.

ctx.x: On the train, yeah. I didn’t realize that Bird knew a lot of things about a lot of, quite a bit about different things. We got back to New York and zero in on Prokofiev, we got to Grand Central Station and Bird was going to pick up his car at Pennsylvania Station. And he said, “Come with me because I just got some more Prokofiev records and we’ll listen to them.” And I’m beat by that time he wanted to go hear some recordings at his place and I said, “I absolutely can’t make it.” Oh there’s another side story here…
